content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 means the service is bundled into another paid service and is a contractual obligation, so the balance cannot be billed to the patient. We've already exhausted the reasonable appeal paths (appeal_with_necessity and correct_and_resubmit) and the payer has upheld CO-97 twice; the low documentation (0.46) offers no basis to demonstrate a separately payable distinct service. Bundling is not a medical-necessity or auth issue, so P2P/records won't help, and resubmission risks CO-18. The correct disposition is a contractual write-off.","action":"write_off"}
